integrity: Exact empty-interval hierarchy and analytic singular limit; two self-contained numerical corroboration scripts, not an external independent audit. No authorship or historical uniqueness claimed.
scientific_limitations: One-dimensional irreversible consecutive-site trimers; rates constant within two alternating starting parities. No monotonicity in rate ratio or general k-mer extension proved. The potentially relevant de Oliveira–Tomé full text was inaccessible; originality is provisional.
title: Parity-resolved trimer jamming with a singular slow-rate crossover
